finding.trigger: BlockSparseMLP.forward receives one flattened token, fully EXL3 expert projections, activate_all_experts=True, and num_experts != num_experts_per_tok.
finding.expected_behavior: Evaluate every expert, either with appropriately sized fused buffers or through the expert-grouped path.
finding.actual_behavior: Routing produces num_experts indices while fused output buffers retain num_experts_per_tok entries. The first exl3_mgemm call checks those dimensions for equality. Parent-tree caller search found TransformerBlock.forward and ParallelDecoderBlock.forward forwarding params to their MLP; this architecture uses TransformerBlock.
